assessment.body:
Thursday 7:30 PM IST. Two days of market losses. Brent above $100. 50,000 US troops. April 25-27 is the convergence point.

MARKETS — TWO CONSECUTIVE FALLS
• Sensex: 77,664 (-853 / -1.09%). Nifty: 24,173 (-206 / -0.84%)
• Two-day combined loss: -1,610 Sensex points (-2%)
• Auto, PSU Bank, Realty worst. Pharma rose (defensive)
• Infosys Q4 beat after hours — NOT yet priced in → potential Friday recovery

INFOSYS Q4 — THE DOMESTIC BRIGHT SPOT
• PAT: Rs 8,501 Cr — UP 21% YoY (massive beat vs Rs 7,500 Cr consensus)
• Revenue: Rs 46,402 Cr (+13.4% YoY, +2% QoQ)
• EPS: Rs 21.01 (+23.8% YoY)
• FY27 guidance: 1.5%-3.5% CC (cautious, below 2-5% consensus — West Asia War impact)
• Stock expected to gap up Friday — partial IT sector recovery possible
• But cautious FY27 guidance = ceiling on IT rally

THE MILITARY BUILD-UP
• 50,000+ US service members now in Middle East (CBS confirmed)
• Typical baseline: 30,000-40,000
• Three carrier strike groups converging: Lincoln (Gulf of Oman), Ford (Red Sea), Bush (Indian Ocean)
• Pre-positioning signal: Trump will use force if Iran misses the 3-5 day window
• Iran's military doctrine: already revised to offensive (Mousavi, confirmed)
• Both sides have maximum forces pre-positioned for resumed conflict

IRAN's DIPLOMATIC SIGNAL
• Pezeshkian: "welcomes dialogue — blockade is the obstacle"
• Ghalibaf: "ceasefire only makes sense without maritime blockade"
• This is Iran's diplomatic wing speaking — IRGC wing is seizing ships
• Internal Iran power struggle between diplomats and IRGC continues
• Door not closed — but IRGC-aligned Supreme Leader must sign off on any deal

THE DUAL DEADLINE — APRIL 25-27
• Trump 3-5 day window from April 22 = ~April 25-27
• Israel-Lebanon 10-day ceasefire = also expires approximately April 27
• Iran explicitly linked Hormuz to Lebanon ceasefire throughout the war
• If Lebanon ceasefire collapses AND Trump deadline passes without Iran proposal: escalation
• Both overlapping deadlines converging on the same 3-day window
• This is the most dangerous convergence since February 28

INDIA'S POSITION
• Brent $101.91 April 22 close — sustained $100+ = OMC hike within 1-2 weeks
• Rupee weakening toward 94.80-95.00
• Sensex -1,610 pts in two sessions
• Infosys beat = partial Friday recovery possible
• April 25-27 = most dangerous window for Indian markets since the war began
• Kharif fertiliser supply risk growing if Hormuz stays closed through May

VERDICT: The West Asia War is entering its most dangerous 72 hours since it began. Trump has 50,000 troops ready. Iran has an offensive military doctrine and a IRGC-aligned Supreme Leader. Brent is above $100 for the first time in a sustained way since the ceasefire. The April 25-27 window — when both Trump's ultimatum and the Lebanon ceasefire expire — will either produce a diplomatic breakthrough or the most destructive escalation of the conflict. India's markets, energy prices, and 280 seafarers' safety all depend on what happens in the next 72 hours.
